top_signal.title: Marketing: am I wrong or is the world wrong?
top_signal.summary: Hey everyone, I'd like your thoughts on marketing.   Small business owner here that primarily works with individuals and businesses to teach, coach, train, advise and mentor corporate leaders and business owners. We've done almost $3M in business in the last 5 years. What we do really works (former executives/experienced business owners that are genuine and supportive, smart, and really lean in to actually help). Our model is a membership (not billed hourly) at three tiers and we do everything from helping with structure, mental models, strategy, management, etc and we pair people based on fit (some of us are more financial, others more versed in strategy and growth, or people). We have helped so many businesses grow and feel better about running their businesses but honestly a little stuck on ours. Our entire business has been referrals and a handful of clients from past collogues and a handful from LinkedIn.   We don't market nor do we really have a clear set of marketing materials or a helpful website. I'm looking for some honest advice from this group. We're growing and business is good, but we'd like to grow faster for some of the folks we just brought in that don't have a deep referall network yet. We just sat down with a marketing coach and I'm allergic to everything she recommended.
